headline: 今日零新片，《怒之杀》领跑热搜
headlineEn: No new releases today; Fury Kill leads trending
summary: 2026年8月24日，今日无新片上映，本周共4部新片。热搜由《怒之杀》领跑，《死神》《特别行动：母狮》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《玩具总动员5》紧随其后。接下来期待《最后的日出》。
summaryEn: On Aug 24, 2026, no movies release today, with 4 new films this week. Trending is led by Fury Kill, followed by Death, Special Ops: Lioness, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and Toy Story 5. Next up: The Last Sunrise.

industryHighlights.text: 今日电影市场零新片上映，档期相对冷清。
industryHighlights.en: No new films hit theaters today, leaving the schedule quiet.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共有4部新片，为观众提供有限的新选择。
industryHighlights.en: A total of 4 new films arrive this week, offering limited fresh options.

industryHighlights.text: 《怒之杀》同时登上今日与本周热搜榜首，热度持续领先。
industryHighlights.en: Fury Kill tops both today's and this week's trending charts, maintaining strong momentum.

industryHighlights.text: 备受关注的新片《最后的日出》正在预热，引发期待。
industryHighlights.en: Highly anticipated upcoming film The Last Sunrise is generating buzz.
